new-york-hudson-valley-rides-hawk-s-nest.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Food stop in New City → High point in Montvale is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.
High point in Montvale → Scenic stretch in Fanwood rides best with patience. Coastal roads change character with wind and visitors; keep overtakes boring and take the photo from a proper stop.

sections.to: Near Manville, on the way back
sections.advice: Scenic stretch in Fanwood → Near Manville, on the way back is the reward section in New York. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.from: Near Manville, on the way back

sections.advice: Photo stop near Little Silver → Near Ridgefield can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.

scenicChapters.title: Karakoram Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 71 km this is Karakoram Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Passu → Khunjerab Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 162 km. 4693 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

karakoram-highway-hunza-karimabad-khunje.story: 233 km from Aliabad to the finish, about 3 h 11 of riding. The highest point is about 4,700 m. It crosses from Pakistan into China - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
